title.cn: 国家博物馆：免费的安静奢侈

text.cn: 免费，但要预约——免费从不等于随便进。展厅安静得像把城市静音了。手机信号像被青铜器吸走。
text.en: Free, but booked — free never means casual entry. Halls mute the city. Phone signal vanishes into bronzes.

text.cn: 有预约：认真看展，做两页笔记（或假装）。
text.en: Booked: deep exhibits, two pages of notes (or fake notes).

lockedHint.cn: 预约常要国内号收验证码。漫游选手请改走现场碰运气。
lockedHint.en: Booking often needs a local number for SMS. Roamers: try walk-up luck.

feedback.cn: 历史展厅让你短暂忘记扫码战争。原来「不弹窗」也可以是一种幸福。
feedback.en: History briefly replaces QR wars. Happiness can mean “no pop-ups”.

text.cn: 碰运气现场入馆：排长队赌人品。
text.en: Walk-up lottery: queue and gamble kindness.

feedback.cn: 挤进去了。脚比大脑先累。你对「余票」两个字产生敬畏。
feedback.en: You’re in. Feet tire before brains. You now revere the words “tickets left”.

text.cn: 看一半去文创店：用冰箱贴收集历史。
text.en: Half exhibits, then gift shop: collect history as magnets.

feedback.cn: 你买到了很有文化的消费。肚子饿，精神还行。
feedback.en: You purchased cultured consumption. Hungry, but sane-ish.

text.cn: 国博日结束。安静是今天最贵的体验——幸好它免费。
text.en: Museum day ends. Quiet was the priciest feeling — luckily free.
